title: The ai and ay Teams
rule: The letters ai and ay are teams that say long a. Underline both letters. We usually find ai in the middle of a word and ay at the end.
trickText: Two letters, one sound: long a. Underline both letters. To choose the spelling, listen: if the sound is at the end of the word, it is usually ay. If it is in the middle, it is usually ai.
say: Today's case: the ai and ay teams. Both say long a. We underline both letters. And here is a clue for spelling: ay is usually at the end of a word, and ai is usually in the middle.

example.say: Look at rain. The a and i are a team. They make one sound, long a. So I underline both letters.

discover.intro: Sort these words. Does the long a team come in the middle, or at the end?

groups.label: In the middle
groups.why: The long a team is in the middle of the word.

groups.label: At the end
groups.why: The long a team is at the end of the word.

discover.question: Which team do we usually see at the end of a word?
discover.reveal: Yes! ay is usually at the end of a word, and ai is usually in the middle. Both are teams, so we underline both letters.

activities.instruction: Code each word. Underline the team. Short vowels get a breve.
